product_metadata.title: AORYVIC Wood Sofa Legs 5 inch Turned Furniture Legs Set of 4 for Couch Armchair Recliner Dresser Cabinet Espresso
features: [Reliable quality] - The legs are made of solid Eucalyptus wood, and well finished with old-fashion espresso color.
[Easy to install] - Accessories are supplied for installation. Mounting plates and screws make installation easy and fast.
[Sturdy adjustment] - The 5 inch turned couch legs help to adjust the height on sofa and loveseat, very sturdy. Better for your knees.
[Upgraded decoration] - The mid-century stylish furniture legs add beauty to your furniture and home décor. You will get lots of compliments from your guests.
[Perfect fit] - The wood replacement legs fit all kinds of furniture, not just sofa and chairs. The legs work on cabinet, dresser, bed, sideboard, coffee table and etc.
